text:
ivy: Quick catch on the dataset card copy — spotted a few small compliance-related nits. Posting mock + suggestions.

jon: link?

ivy: https://figma.redwood/dataset-card-v4 — focus on top meta row: region, retention, encryption badge.

ivy: issues I noticed: 1) Region shows short code only (e.g., 'eu'). confusing. 2) Retention shows number w/out unit in list view. 3) encryption badge reads 'KMS' only which is ambiguous for users.

mira: agree on ambiguity. For encryption we should surface "management" not raw acronym. Security preference: show human-friendly alias or 'Redwood-managed' / 'Customer-managed' but never show raw key material.

jon: copy proposals: 
- Region compact: "Region: eu-west-1 (EU)"
- Retention compact: "Retention: 180 days"
- Encryption badge (short): "Encrypted — Redwood-managed" or "Encrypted — Customer KMS"

rachel: a11y: badges must be actionable elements with keyboard target. If badge opens details, make it a button with aria-haspopup=dialog and aria-label that explains state (e.g., "Encrypted with customer-managed key"). Also avoid relying solely on color to convey state.

ivy: good. UX note: in list/compact rows we have very little horizontal space. prefer short labels. In expanded row or modal we can show the longer description and link to audit.

jon: sample compact badge HTML we could use: `<button class="meta-badge" aria-haspopup="dialog" aria-label="Encrypted (Redwood-managed keys)">🔒 Encrypted</button>`

mira: audit log copy: current entries look machiney like `ENCRYPTION: key=abc-123`. Replace with action-style lines: `Encryption applied — key alias: redwood-prod-01 (KMS); actor: infra-service; id: req-0a1b`

ivy: +1. We should also add a short hover/press interaction that reveals the alias (not full key) and a "View audit" CTA.

rachel: contrast: current green on badge fails for small text. We should either darken or switch to green border + dark text. Also ensure focus ring uses the system focus color and is high contrast.

jon: I'll propose two color passes: darken to #0E7A52 OR outline variant where icon is green and text is #0F1724. Which do you prefer?

rachel: outline variant preferred for compact sizes — text stays readable and it meets AA. Icon can be decorative with aria-hidden=true.

ivy: mobile behavior: no hover. tapping the badge should open a bottom sheet with: header "Encryption — dataset: <name>", short line "Managed by: Redwood / Customer KMS (alias)", and a "View audit" link to open full audit modal/page. Keep the sheet to 2-3 rows of info.

mira: confirm that bottom sheet does not show key material and that we log full key IDs only in admin audit pages (per policy). Security OK with alias + actor + timestamp.

jon: small wording proposals for audit lines: `Encryption applied — key: redwood-prod-01 (KMS); actor: redwood-service; time: 2025-12-02 16:10 UTC`

ivy: perfect. Also we should add a policy indicator next to retention when org overrides retention. e.g., `Retention: 30 days (set by org policy)` with a lock icon and tooltip pointing to settings.

rachel: tooltip accessibility: role=tooltip, aria-hidden=false when visible, and it should be dismissed with Esc. Also ensure the tooltip does not trap focus. For the lock icon, include aria-hidden=true and make the policy text programmatically visible.

jon: implementation note: in compact list we will show `Retention: 30 days` and append `• policy` visually when overridden. Clicking opens dataset retention settings.

ivy: checklist before I close this thread: 
- Jon: finalize compact copy + CSS approach for badge (outline vs solid)
- Rachel: run accessibility run on staging once preview is up
- Mira: confirm audit fields to show in modal (alias, actor, timestamp, request id)
- Jon/ivy: update mobile bottom sheet pattern to match dataset detail pattern

ux-ci-bot: preview deployed: https://staging.redwood/preview/dataset-meta-v4 — build #4207 (branch: dataset-meta-copy-nits)

jon: pushing a small PR with the outline variant and aria labels. Will include screenshots.

rachel: quick follow: in screen reader testing, prefer `Encrypted. Managed by Redwood` vs `Encrypted — Redwood-managed` for better pause/intonation. small tweak.

ivy: noted. we'll use the SR text variant and keep compact visible text as the shorter phrasing. Thanks everyone. Closing when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
